company.name: Shape
company.shortDescription: ShapeScale combines computer vision and 3D into a new form of measuring health and fitness.
company.description: ShapeScale is a personal 3D scanner that digitizes and measures your body in photorealistic 3D. Leveraging computer vision and deep learning ShapeScale measures changes in body composition your eyes and conventional scales do not see. With fast, visual, and gamified feedback, ShapeScale changes how people keep healthy and stay motivated.

productsAndServices.description: A 3D body-scanning scale that measures weight, body composition, body dimensions, and regional changes using computer vision, depth sensing, and photorealistic imaging.
productsAndServices.name: ShapeScale

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for viewing ShapeScale scans, body measurements, composition data, localized change heatmaps, scores, and progress comparisons over time.
productsAndServices.name: ShapeScale App

productsAndServices.description: A commercial body-composition tracking solution that helps fitness, wellness, healthcare, and aesthetics businesses scan clients, manage profiles, generate reports, and monitor progress.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,919,950, or 21.88% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,366,869 to $26,998,790, a 11.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Fit3D, Styku, Naked Labs.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
